hotspots.title: Trump bans major media outlets from White House access
hotspots.blurb: President Trump's directive barring CNN, MS NOW, and Politico from White House press access has drawn severe condemnation across media organizations and watchdog groups. The move has triggered internal MAGA friction and widespread debate over First Amendment protections, with critics accusing the administration of authoritarian overreach.
hotspots.affect: This story commands massive affective charge by directly threatening press freedom norms and sparking intense anti-media rhetoric versus civil liberty alarms.

hotspots.title: Trump weighs renewed Iran strikes amid growing public opposition
hotspots.blurb: President Trump is considering renewed military strikes against Iran ahead of consultations with foreign leaders, despite polling indicating record-high voter opposition to foreign conflict. Congressional figures and voters express deep alarm over potential casualties, economic strain, and a perceived lack of strategic clarity.
hotspots.affect: The prospect of regional war creates high affective anxiety and war-weariness that directly clashes with hawkish executive decision-making.

hotspots.title: Trump administration advances major arms sales amidst regional tensions
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration has approved a $24.3 billion sale of 48 F-35 fighter jets to Saudi Arabia amid escalating Houthi strikes in the region. The decision signals a massive strategic commitment to Middle Eastern allies while drawing scrutiny over defense industrial priorities.
hotspots.affect: High monetary stakes and global military escalation generate significant concern over long-term geopolitical risks and arms proliferation.

hotspots.title: Trump's proposed DC Arch and Kennedy Center demolition threat
hotspots.blurb: Protests have erupted over President Trump's threat to demolish or alter the Kennedy Center if denied naming rights, alongside ongoing pushback against a planned triumphal arch in Washington. A federal court has intervened, requiring the administration to issue 30 days' advance notice prior to taking any destructive action.
hotspots.affect: The conflict taps into intense moral and cultural outrage surrounding the preservation of civic heritage against unilateral executive actions.

hotspots.title: State lawsuits and court rulings challenge Trump administration policies
hotspots.blurb: Federal judges and state officials continue to issue rulings restricting core administrative actions, including blocking penalties regarding state SNAP benefit administration. Legal challenges are expanding across immigration rules, voter roll access, and executive enforcement mandates.
hotspots.affect: Systemic legal resistance and judicial pushback channel high partisan frustration over state sovereignty and federal authority.
